notes: The exposure imagery depicts public sexual humiliation in the judgment on Nineveh; its violence is left visible.
No-amon is the city named in the Hebrew. The comparison recalls its defeat despite natural defenses and allies; the killing and enslavement of its people are explicit.
The comparison of warriors to women is an ancient military taunt, not a claim about women’s worth.
The locust verb can describe stripping a place or shedding its skin before flying away; the image stresses disappearance after devastation.
vocabulary: A name for Thebes in Egypt.
The swarming insects become an image of officials who vanish when conditions change.
